title: Doctor verifies one read snapshot so a concurrent commit cannot produce false invalid findings
outcome: Doctor verifies one read snapshot so a concurrent commit cannot produce false invalid findings
acceptance: A test commits a completion between the object scan and the projection checks of a concurrent verification and the report stays healthy; the same commit before the verification also stays healthy
The doctor output names the snapshot it verified (object count and project feed position) so a later healthy run is comparable

verify_all and every integrity entry point run inside one read transaction (reusing an already active one), so a writer committing between the object scan and the projection checks changes nothing the verifier compares

completion.summary: Delivered one read snapshot across all integrity entry points and captured doctor snapshot disclosure, with deterministic completion interleaving and savepoint tests; landed e72f39c after nine gates and review closure.
